tropical_outlook: NHC Atlantic outlook (Nov 2, 2026): no active tropical cyclones. One disturbance expected to form along a weakening front a few hundred miles NE of the Bahamas, 30% 7-day development odds (would be Subtropical Storm Kyle); it is forecast to move E/NE away from land by the weekend and NHC/local outlets say it poses no threat to the U.S. No threat to Miami, Charlotte, Madrid, Gulf or East Coast for Week 9. A separate East/Central Pacific low SE of Hawaii (70% 7-day) is irrelevant to Week 9 venues. Sources: https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/gtwo.php?basin=atlc&fdays=7 ; https://cbs12.com/weather/hurricane-stories/nhc-raises-development-odds-for-western-atlantic-disturbance-tropics-hurricanes-november-kyle-invest-florida-bahamas-treasure-coast-palm-beaches

2026_09_JAX_BAL.conditions: Mild and humid ahead of a front; showers likely with an isolated thunderstorm possible during the game
2026_09_JAX_BAL.notes: NWS Baltimore/Washington (via Country Herald, issued ~Nov 2-3): Thu high ~73-74F, 50% showers/thunderstorms during day; Thu night rain likely 60%, low ~61F. 2026_09_CIN_ATL.notes: Sources disagree: Tutiempo/Thomas Cook/Easeweather show partly cloudy, highs 16-18C (61-64F), 0% precip; CBS Sports Week 9 preview says 'rain in the forecast for Sunday' but notes retractable roof means weather won't be a problem.
